initialPrompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original speculative product photography for a café website, ONE PORTRAIT contact sheet, exactly1024×1536pixels, TWOcolumns and THREErows of exactly SIX512×512SQUAREcells. Cells touch edge-to-edge at x512,y512,y1024, no gutters, divider lines, frame, captions, letters, words, numbers, logo or UI.
Continuity: same welcoming neighborhood Italian café across all cells, muted teal-green walls, walnut tables and bar, brass pendant lights, light wood chairs, ordinary patrons in contemporary clothing. The physical café stays realistic and warm, never a neon sci-fi chamber. Calm real cafe materials and moderate luminous cyan/violet projection light.
SIX INDEPENDENT SCENES IN EXACT ORDER:
TOPLEFT (home): real walnut café table, an entire compact low cylindrical physical tabletop projector clearly visible, emitting subtle rays upward to one white espresso cup with saucer and one golden croissant as luminous translucent VOLUMETRIC REPLICAS floating directly above it. Whole cup handle, saucer and pastry visible, normal recognizable anatomy. Real café people and soft teal wall behind. Replicas show appetizing real food forms and restrained iridescent edges, not empty wireframes.
TOPRIGHT (locale): wide credible photographic view of the cozy café interior, teal wall, walnut bar, brass lights, light wood chairs, friendly barista and a few welcoming patrons. Subtle small projector on a table can echo the product idea, but architecture and people remain physical realistic café subjects.
MIDDLELEFT (coffee): ONE whole compact physical projector base on walnut table, projecting TWO detailed luminous volumetric cup replicas above it: small espresso cup and larger cappuccino cup, both plain white ceramic forms with full handles and complete saucers, believable coffee and milk foam. Visible projection rays, no flat screens.
MIDDLERIGHT (pastry): ONE whole compact physical projector base on walnut table, projecting ONE croissant and ONE cinnamon roll with a complete small serving tray as luminous volumetric replicas. Normal appetizing pastry silhouettes and lamination, true cinnamon spiral. Entire tray, pastries and device safely inset, never touching the tile edge.
BOTTOMLEFT (tea): ONE whole physical projector base on walnut table, projecting TWO whole volumetric vessel replicas above it: handled clear glass of amber tea and taller clear glass of iced orange juice. Whole handles, rims and bases visible, normal readable beverage colors. Subtle luminous edges and clear projection source.
BOTTOMRIGHT (frontage): authentic realistic photograph of this café entrance and large window, teal-painted wood, a completely EMPTY physically blank sign over entrance, one pot plant, TWO DISTINCT whole outdoor tables, one on each side of doorway. Two clearly separate tabletops, complete doorway and blank sign. No futuristic architecture, neon or lettering.
Framing: every primary group, projector and its floating replicas fits wholly within its own square cell with at least10percent safe margin. Center each food group using no more than70percent of its cell width and height, so the entire projector base and all cup handles/saucers/glassbases/traycorners are visible. No object crosses a cell boundary.
Medium: polished believable cinematic editorial photographs of speculative volumetric projector concepts in a real café. Skin, timber and food remain naturally textured, projection light moderate and pale, warm natural café ambience. No intense flare, darkness, neon chrome, cyberpunk plastic, screen rectangles, holographic text, labels, wearable visor, phone, tablet, diagram, decorative borders or added captions.
